'''Talhovi''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[House Mekuun|Mekuun family]], with whom the [[Ancient Houses]] of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region had prohibited trade. Talhovi nevertheless remained economically powerful and exported goods such as [[Talhovian ale]].

==Description==
Talhovi was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Talhovi system/Legends|Talhovi system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[K'ath system/Legends|K'ath]], [[Little Talhovi system/Legends|Little Talhovi]], and [[Thull's Vault system/Legends|Thull's Vault systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Talhovi was a cosmopolitan world that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[House Mekuun|Mekuun family]]. The Mekuuns had originally been one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex, but, while rebelling against the other Houses around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the region's tumultous [[553 BBY]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] event known as the [[Crimson Days]], their House had dissolved itself and had sought to reconstitute itself as a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

The other Ancient Houses had subsequently prohibited trade with the Mekuuns; however, Talhovi's economic power and steady flow of desirable exports,<ref name="TEA" /> which included the [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] known as [[Talhovian ale]],<ref name="DN1" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> allowed the family to continue its experimenting with an alternate form of governance. Talhovi attracted both [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] from outside the region and members of the other Houses who chose to ignore the trade prohibition.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talhovi was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. Although the Talhovi [[Star system/Legends|system]] was placed in grid square K-18 on the book's map of the Senex-Juvex, its Appendix section<ref name="TEA" /> as well as the later [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book both erroneously placed it in square L-18 instead.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
